note: Primary: Steam store page of Age of Empires IV: Raiders of the North (app 4336170), released 29 Oct 2026, 74.00 AED (AE) and 79.00 SR (SA) read 17:25Z; official Release Trailer (Steam) and Xbox's 'Available Now' upload 17:00Z. Platforms PC, Xbox and PS5 and USD 19.99 per the Xbox store listing and Notebookcheck; needs the Anniversary Edition. Sound: release trailer from 34.0 s, music only (battle shouts and narration end at 33.0 s; transcriber finds no words from 33.5 to 74 s). Pictures: RTS footage is wide by nature, so the shots are the fleet, the charging army, a Scottish village, a siege and the castle on the water; no key art or title cards.
